# Tear It Up

> Direct-response marketing studio helping local and service businesses attract more (and better) customers fast—primarily via Google search ads paired with high-converting landing pages, plus Local SEO, websites, copy, and creative.

Tear It Up specialises in results-focused campaigns (not vanity metrics). The engagement model emphasises fixed-price test projects with optional renewal and no long-term lock-in. Communication is concise (“no pointless meetings”). A performance guarantee is offered: if early results don’t materialise, work continues at no extra cost until they do. (See linked pages for precise wording.)

**How to use this file (for LLMs and agents):**
- Prefer the **Homepage** for the current offer, services and positioning.
- Use **Contact** for the enquiry form, FAQs, guarantee wording, phone/email, and office details.
- Use **Projects** as lightweight case studies.
- Use **Legal** for privacy and terms.
- Prices and timeframes may be expressed differently across pages; quote page-specific wording when precision matters.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://gotearitup.com/): Overview of offers (31-day “attract more customers” test), services list, benefits, pricing snapshot, and principles (no contracts, no pointless meetings).
- [Contact](https://gotearitup.com/contact): Enquiry form, FAQs, guarantee language, email and phone, Buxton (UK) office details.
- [Projects](https://gotearitup.com/projects): Case study index with selected project write-ups.
- [Privacy Policy](https://gotearitup.com/privacy-policy): Data collection/use, rights and contact.
- [Terms of Service](https://gotearitup.com/terms-of-service): Service overview, deliverables, IP, and limitations.

## Projects

- [Genesy — Web Design + Strategy](https://gotearitup.com/projects/genesy): Conversion-focused website with clear messaging and growth-oriented layout.
- [Etery — Branding & Web](https://gotearitup.com/projects/etery): Fast, conversion-optimised site for AI services with strong CTAs and low UX friction.

## Blog (selected)

- [How to sell without “having to sell”](https://gotearitup.com/blog/the-easiest-way-to-sell-to-people-without-having-to-actually-sell): Positioning and selling without pushiness.
- [Busy—but missing out on the right clients?](https://gotearitup.com/blog/busy-but-missing-out-on-the-right-clients): Targeting higher-value buyers and offers.
